summary: Iter40 — Party detail + Ledger main redesign VERIFIED end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844). All 11 acceptance points pass. Party detail: 3-card summary (DEBIT rgb(255,68,68) / CREDIT rgb(0,255,136) / YOU'LL GET rgb(255,255,255)) renders side-by-side; INR/THB pill toggle swaps correctly (active pill bg rgb(0,255,136), inactive transparent w/ rgba(255,255,255,0.2) border); switching to THB replaces summary numbers with ฿0 and shows 'No THB transactions in FY 2026-27'; bottom buttons bg rgb(255,68,68) / rgb(0,255,136), 50px tall; statement rows are 44px min-height; description truncation logic present (short data didn't hit 60-char threshold). Ledger main: 'Verified: <date> ✓' line rgba(255,255,255,0.5) with ✓ in rgb(0,255,136); 'Not verified yet' in rgb(255,215,0); 'Last entry:' line in rgba(255,255,255,0.5); balance-tag colours match YOU'LL GET rgb(0,255,136) / YOU'LL GIVE rgb(255,68,68); INR always visible on the right, THB only when non-zero (verified against multiple rows); search, filter chips, top receivables/payables card and FAB unchanged. No React 'rendered more hooks' warnings, no new console errors — only the pre-existing shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents/resizeMode RN-Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Rules-of-Hooks respected: `selectedCcy`, `ccyInitialised`, `activeTotal` and `filteredDisplayRows` are declared BEFORE the loading/not-found early returns in party/[id].tsx (lines 121-138).
StatementRow sub-component correctly encapsulates its own useState(expanded) so per-row expand/collapse doesn't inflate the parent render tree.
Ledger row uses explicit hex colours (#FF4444/#00FF88/#FFD700) as spec requires — no dependency on the theme `colors.ok/danger` heuristic for these lines.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Party detail (app/party/[id].tsx) and ledger main (app/ledger.tsx) redesigns are stable. Currency toggle testIDs: `ccy-toggle-INR` / `ccy-toggle-THB`. Bottom action testIDs: `party-you-gave-btn` / `party-you-got-btn`. Deepak Adavani (1d4908d1-5134-4b6f-8e60-9fc67543a6f0) has 1 INR statement row and 0 THB rows in FY 2026-27; use another party (e.g. Somchai — end-customer) if THB rows are needed for further checks.
